title: Clothing Boutique Design 140 m², Kyiv | DUMSKAYA DESIGN
description: 140 m² clothing boutique in Kyiv: interior design, 3D visualization, furniture design and turnkey renovation. DUMSKAYA DESIGN, Bratislava and Vienna.
h1: Interior design of a women’s clothing boutique in Kyiv, Ukraine

blocks.text: Interior design of a women’s clothing boutique in Kyiv, Ukraine

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) designed the interior and carried out a turnkey renovation of a 140 m² women’s clothing boutique in Kyiv, Ukraine.
The goal was an interior that shows off the collections to their best advantage, supports the boutique’s brand identity, and makes customers feel comfortable.
The concept is built around the collection display areas, customer flow, lighting, and visual accents, keeping the sales floor open and spacious.
The project took into account the placement of the main functional areas:

items: retail racks, shelving, and storage systems;

parts.html: Shelving, display cases, clothing racks, counters, and storage systems were designed for this specific space and integrated into the interior.

In a clothing store, lighting shapes how colors and materials are perceived and how merchandise is presented, so the lighting scheme highlights the collections, interior details, and the boutique’s main areas.
Photorealistic 3D visualizations showed the boutique’s layout, furniture, materials, and lighting before the renovation began, and the concept was approved on that basis.

blocks.text: Turnkey design and renovation of a commercial space

parts.html: The studio managed the project from concept to turnkey renovation: design, technical solutions, furniture, materials, and lighting were all handled by one team.

Need turnkey design and renovation for a boutique, store, office, or beauty salon? DUMSKAYA DESIGN creates stylish and functional commercial interiors — from concept and 3D visualization to full implementation.
